name: compress.deflate
doc:
Raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) streams. The coder is C (runtime/src/std_compress.c,
reached through the compress rt* externs); this file is the API:
one-shot Compress/Decompress and the streaming Writer/Reader, which work
on []byte chunks of any size.

items.name: Compress
items.doc: Compresses data at level 0 (store) .. 9 (best); -1 is the default (6).

items.name: Decompress
items.doc: Decompresses a complete raw DEFLATE stream. Bytes after its end are an error.
items.summary: Decompresses a complete raw DEFLATE stream.

items.name: Reader
items.summary: A streaming decompressor: Feed compressed chunks as they arrive, take the decompressed bytes with Read().

members.name: Feed
members.doc: Decompresses a chunk of input; fails on corrupt data.
members.summary: Decompresses a chunk of input; fails on corrupt data.

members.name: Read
members.doc: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.
members.summary: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.

members.name: Rest
members.doc: The input after the end of the stream (a trailer, the next member...).
members.summary: The input after the end of the stream (a trailer, the next member...).

members.name: Close
members.doc: Fails if the stream did not end.
members.summary: Fails if the stream did not end.

items.name: Writer
items.doc:
A streaming compressor: Write plain bytes, take the compressed output
with Bytes() whenever convenient; Flush makes everything written so far
decodable (sync flush); Close ends the stream.
items.summary: A streaming compressor: Write plain bytes, take the compressed output with Bytes() whenever convenient; Flush makes everything written so far decodable (sync flush); Close ends the stream.

members.name: Flush
members.doc: Compresses the buffered input; the output is byte-aligned afterwards.
members.summary: Compresses the buffered input; the output is byte-aligned afterwards.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Ends the stream (further Writes panic); Close twice is a no-op.
members.summary: Ends the stream (further Writes panic); Close twice is a no-op.

members.name: Bytes
members.doc: The compressed bytes produced since the last call.
members.summary: The compressed bytes produced since the last call.
